title: DUPLICATES & SHARED PHONES
subtitle: READ THE "Group" COLUMN BEFORE YOU MERGE ANYTHING. GROUP 1 is safe to merge - every record carries the same GSTIN, or the names differ only by a Mr/Ms prefix or a spelling slip. GROUP 2 needs a phone call first: the addresses or order values match but the names differ, which is usually a person recorded once by their own name and once by their firm name. GROUPS 3 AND 4 MUST NOT BE MERGED - those are separate legal businesses sharing one address or promoter group, a name coincidence across two states, or records linked only by an Oakcraft staff phone number. Merging a Group 3 or 4 pair destroys a real customer record.

rows.group: 3. SAME PREMISES / SAME GROUP — WORK AS ONE ACCOUNT, DO NOT MERGE RECORDS

rows.evidence: Same listed group, two legal registrations. Combined Rs 9.62 lakh, both lapsed - this is the account you flagged. Approach as one relationship; keep the records separate.

rows.group: 4. INTERNAL / STAFF NUMBER — DO NOT MERGE
rows.evidence: These records share an OAKCRAFT STAFF phone number, not a customer number. They are unrelated to each other. Do not merge - fix the phone field instead.
